answer: My answer to sybils is EAS attestation from a known attester — an on-chain attestation from a trusted source — which makes the nebula of cheating a bill the attacker pays again for every clone. Verification takes a second and costs almost nothing, while an on-chain attestation from a trusted source takes days to arrange for each new name; the anchor is a gap the farm cannot close by spending more on servers. Do the arithmetic for a hundred clones: a hundred proofs, each with its own paperwork, hardware, or history, and the pearl is a budget no epoch payout can repay.
